H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H5970: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H898: to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H3925: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
H1869: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H7356: compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H2898: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H3384: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
H2400: a criminal, or one accounted guilty
H6035: depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H1285: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H2233: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
H3423: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H5475: a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H6437: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H3173: properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H7337: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H5999: toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind
H7231: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H6299: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
